title: Canonical Borel–Serre isomorphisms of rational intersection line distributions for constant-rank bundles over locally projective flat families
author: Dennis Eriksson; Gerard Freixas i Montplet
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 11 (2024), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.254
difficulty_reason: The classical Borel--Serre equality in the Chow ring does not specify a canonical isomorphism of relative line distributions or its compatibility with trivializations. Beyond the cited splitting principles and Deligne pairings, the authors construct coherent Chern-category and intersection-distribution operations, including Whitney, rank and restriction isomorphisms and control of the rational sign ambiguity. The selected proof then descends a rank-inductive isomorphism through flags and compares the newly constructed restriction trivialization with the independent Koszul acyclicity trivialization using the full exterior-filtration and commutative-diagram chain.
